lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour. Candidate renders are S/r47 (q15-q17, timestamped after the b65def4 build and listed in r47/pairs.json with the new q17 camera) and S/s47 (studio); the brief's 'S/r46' for the candidate is taken as a typo, because S/r46 holds the w46 renders at the old q17 camera. Before/after for q17 uses S/r46c. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/2fb1f2ef-fbd7-5fb9-b7d2-14a3db7265c8/scratchpad/raterB47/: m.py and c2.py measure cover colour and column profiles; b.py measures the smooth-pixel cover area; t.py gives the teal strap bbox, principal axis and median, plus navy smooth-pixel medians; p.py counts dark-grey under-arm pixels. Blend and pair crops are q17_blend.png, q17_pair.png, q17_upperR.png, q17_pansR.png, q17_left.png, q15_crop.png and studio_A/B/C.png. I read the b65def4 diff of 09a_econ.js.
calibrationNote: Camera check: the 50 % blend of r47 q17 with y_47303 lines up the near and second-row aisle arm noses to within a few pixels (near right arm top at y 312 in both), and the window tops at y ~85 match. The windows are out of phase horizontally, which is the known layout residual. One residual the resection did not remove: the seat-back tops sit 30-48 px higher than in the photo. The near right back top is at y 106-122 vs 152-154, so back-top-to-arm is 190-206 px vs 158. The left-column back tops are 32 px higher, screen bottoms 25 px higher and pockets 20 px higher. The offset grows with height. Head-on q15, the back height/width ratio is 1.95 vs 1.87 (+4 %). So I put about 1/4 of this on geometry and 3/4 on the camera or lens (landmarks only at arm and window height) (w47b-3). With the camera matched, my w44b-1 cover strip is gone: the near cover spans 74 px vertically vs 68 in the photo, and its smooth area is 4144 vs 4942 px. The match exposes a colour gap instead: the q17 cover reads darker and more violet than the photo's silver flap (w47b-1). Geometry fixes this round are measurable: under-arm dark-grey px fell from 2054 to 533 (photo 204); the near-left belt layout now matches the photo; the e11 over-lip flap is gone; the pocket mesh is lit grey with a blue header; the hood shelf and the screen lips read in e5/e2. Detail mean 8.47 (w46 8.44). Overall 8.55: up 0.05 on the w44-w46 scale for the belt, plate and pocket fixes, and held there by the cover colour and the right-seat strap.

priorIssues.note: The mid-pan V and latch are gone; straps now lie across the rear half with a steel tongue and a light buckle cover. Near-left seat matches y_47303: teal bbox h/w 1.46, axis 58 deg, vs photo 1.88 / 78 deg; buckle cover and navy diagonal in the same places. Near-right seat does not: render teal 121 x 90 px, axis 39 deg, running along the arm, vs photo teal 39 x 45 px, axis 59 deg, a short drop to the tongue. The render navy also stops ~40 px short of the photo's run under the arm front. e11 over-lip flap removed, so there is no step (fixed). At the resected camera the near cover spans y 142-216 on column x 700 vs photo y 202-270 on column x 722 (74 vs 68 px). Smooth cover px 4144 vs 4942 (84 %). It no longer reads as a strip, so no geometry change is needed. The old box metric (640-740 x 60-220, >= 8600) does not apply to the new camera. Teal G/R 1.88 (target >= 1.7). Navy smooth px luma 65-67 vs photo 52-53: now slightly light, 2 over the 50-65 target (w47b-4).
q15 side-block teal (62,115,170) B/R 2.74 (w46 2.61-2.65; check <= 2.4). y_47300 shows no teal px in those boxes.

Unchanged: the q15 crop shows the pillow is still a flat rectangle where y_47300's pillows are puffy with pinched corners; e11 still shows the dark edge under the pan front; fleck contrast is unchanged. The centre-block stubs under the pillows are unchanged.
